basic_profile.bio: A Maryland native in my late 30s, I've been a Reddit user for half a decade now. By day, I work as a civil engineer, but my heart is in exploring the realms of Middle-earth and jamming to King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard. I enjoy sharing memes, especially those involving LOTR, and keeping up with local news and events in Maryland. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings browsing Reddit, usually between 7 PM and midnight Eastern Time. With a moderate interest in legal advice and community discussions, I often find myself diving into subreddits that offer a mix of humor and information, especially in times of global events like the COVID-19 pandemic.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a strong background in engineering, I've honed my analytical skills over years of professional experience. My love for LOTR and progressive rock bands like King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard have made me well-versed in fantasy literature and music trivia. I often share insights and engage in discussions about these topics.
